strengths: zone border and title block make a convincing, ownable navy drawing sheet
one part drawing per column is clear and buildable as SVG
light headline, mono codes and square corners match the brand
weaknesses: upper-right vessel drawings duplicate the column art and add nothing
part drawings are generic; the pipe spool has no relation to 'registration'
filler text ('utility labels tiny metadata') and garbled title block labels
stray dark UI strip with leftover chat labels below the sheet
no steel-blue accent; vessels hint at stainless styling
brand_fit_why: A navy drawing sheet with light type, mono codes and hairline part drawings is on-brand, but filler text, duplicated art and no accent weaken it.
